title: Inside the Hagia Sophia Dome
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mediterranean Travels
description: Hover over eight numbered parts of the Hagia Sophia dome in cross-section, from the piers to the ring of windows, to learn what holds it up and which parts are Justinian's, rebuilt, or Ottoman, then test yourself in Quiz mode.

educational.topic: The structure of the Hagia Sophia dome
learningObjectives: The learner will name the parts that hold up the Hagia Sophia dome, say what each one does, and tell which parts are Justinian's, which came after the collapse of 558, and which are later Ottoman additions.
prerequisites: The Hagia Sophia dome and Justinian, from [Chapter 4](../../chapters/04-byzantine-constantinople/index.md).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Interactive exploration followed by retrieval practice
keyQuestions: What is Justinian's, rebuilt, or Ottoman?
commonMisconceptions: All the buttresses were added by the Ottomans.
assessmentOpportunities: Quiz mode: identify each marked part from its description

controls.name: Explore
controls.description: Default mode: hover a marker or label to read about that part.

controls.name: Quiz
controls.description: Hides the labels and asks you to click the marker that matches each description.
